identity.tagline: Crafts pi-coding-agent extensions - hash-anchored edits, Tor-wrapped requests, cloud models.

paragraphs: Author of pi-coding-agent extensions (8 published TypeScript packages on npm), a dependency-free Python file server, and a personal pi configuration repo. All repos are MIT-licensed where licensed, and the account has been active since 2022.

projects.name: pi-hashline-edit-pro
projects.description: Hash-anchored read/replace/undo tools for the pi coding agent; every line gets a unique 3-char hash

projects.name: pi-tor-proxy
projects.description: Self-contained Pi extension to route all requests through Tor

projects.name: pi-cloud-ollama
projects.description: Registers Ollama Cloud as a provider in pi-coding-agent with live model discovery

projects.name: pi-context-inspector
projects.description: Tabbed overlay with the full LLM context of the current pi session

projects.name: pi-git-commit
projects.description: Safe commit flow for pi: bash git guard + git_commit tool + /commit

projects.name: pi-msg-queue
projects.description: Queues follow-up messages in pi via /q

projects.name: pi-msg-workflow
projects.description: Numbered message and command stores plus configurable improvement workflows (/msg, /cmd, /workflow)

projects.name: pi-multi-web-search
projects.description: web_search tool with Exa to Brave to Tavily fallback

projects.name: pi-tps-status
projects.description: Live tokens-per-second status widget for pi

projects.name: mypi
projects.description: My personal pi configuration: extensions, models, and settings

projects.name: browser-file-server
